why_placeholder: The value has no argued basis anywhere in this corpus and this build does not invent one. `>= -1e17` is not trivially true over the unconstrained integers -- Z3 finds a counterexample at -1e18 and a naive proof arm ADMITS the predicate. DECISION RULE while this reads PLACEHOLDER: `proof_arm` returns UNKNOWN for every pure-bound predicate and routes it to the empirical arm.
